5ca6748a37b88b269472dad9: The PAW Patrol must help Alex find his backpack for the first day of school; the PAW Patrol must work to restore the power when a storm causes it to go out.
Molly, Gil and the Guppies celebrate summer with lots of outdoor fun; Gil uses his camping skills to rescue Bubble Puppy during the Summer Camp Games.
When the evil robot Major Bummer tries to eliminate music from the galaxy, Princess Molly and the Guppies must restore peace, harmony and melody.

When Rubble's favorite baseball star Aaron Judge can't get out of town to the home run derby, Rubble & Crew build a stadium to hold the derby right in Builder Cove; Surf's up for Rubble & Crew, if they can get over the super hot sand.

Rubble and Crew build a kangaroo safari for Lucas and Lily right in the back yard until their construction kangaroo hops away; Speed Meister challenges Rubble and crew to compete in the ultimate build-off, builder Cove's first construction games.
The children try to teach Mr. Grumpfish about their favorite things when he is their substitute teacher.
While visiting another town, a snooty car traps all the racers, and Blaze must become a racecar to free his new friends.
Blaze and his friends join the Truck Rangers, a scouting club where trucks earn badges for their accomplishments.
When Swoops the helicopter loses his rotor, Blaze and AJ head to the Sky Track to try and retrieve it.
When Blaze smells smoke at Axle City's garage, he calmly and courageously leads his friends outside to safety.
Blaze, AJ and Stripes try to stay on track while searching for a magical treasure that will grant a wish for one lucky race car.
Blaze transforms into a tow truck and, with AJ and Gabby's help, sets off on an awesome adventure to save Stripes.
Blaze and AJ must track down the missing pieces of Gabby's Truck Wash and rebuild it, so their friends can get clean.
Blaze and Zeg are on Animal Island when they discover a world of tiny creatures right under their tires called Insect City.
The Axle City toy store's amazing machine can make any toy one wants; when Crusher uses it to make massive toys that run amok, only Blaze and Watts can stop the giant toys from making a giant mess.

Baddy teams up with Betty, Chomps and Rocco to hijack the HQ Command Flyer so he can take over Big Swirl; Davey Hasselhawg has to get Cheep, Chirp and friends ready for an awesome wakeboard show when Brody is called to a rescue.

The cadets must rescue Earl and race him back to Big Swirl before his Coco Cruiser ruins the little Turkski's birthday party; Inspector Eagle-Eye wants to send the cadets to different Top Wing training centers to be lead cadets.
When Brody's turbo-surfin' friends get trapped in a cave, Brody and Penny race against the tide to rescue them; the Cadets try to earn a badge by running the Lemon Shack.

Brody has to rescue his turbo-surfing pals when they get caught in the Shipwreck Cove whirlpool; Brody and Team Top Wing race to the rescue when Brody's little sister slips off the top of Puffin Peak.

While the cadets work on their snowboarding badge, a falling tree knocks a gondola loose; the Cadets help Davey Hasselhawg give the little Turkskis a swim lesson, and then have to rescue Davey from a whirlpool.
The cadets help Timmy Turtle when he drops his new lunch box in the river; the cadets race for a trophy, but Brody must choose between winning and rescuing a competitor.
Ryder, Chase and Rubble plan to help sea turtle hatchlings cross the road safely; the PAW Patrol must work together to save a beached baby whale.

When Luke Stars gets stuck on a ledge, Ryder and Marshall rush to the rescue; Mayor Goodway's big plans for Chicken Day become threatened when the Chicken of Honor, Chickaletta, mysteriously disappears.
When the postman's truck gets stuck in the mud, the mail is stuck in a tree; Mayor Goodway turns into a frog.
Sid Swashbuckle the Pirate and his first pup mate, Arrby, steal the giant pearl-making shell that gives Puplantis its magic.
Rocky helps repair the tires on the Adventure Bay school bus; Ryder and Chase search for missing songbirds.
The pups must come to the rescue when Sweetie plans to steal the royal throne so that she can rule.
The pups need to get a sleepwalking bear back home before he wakes up; Daring Danny X takes his horse off the trail and ends up on a wild ride.
When Crusher tries to cheat at a carnival game, he accidentally strands himself and Pickle on a giant rocket.
On the day of the Team Truck Challenge, Crusher chooses someone other than Pickle as his partner, which disappoints Pickle.

A visit to the King's castle goes awry when the King accidentally catapults himself far, far away; to bring him home, Blaze, AJ, and the King's adorable pet dragon, Zeek, must transform into knights in shining armor.
There are incredible riches just waiting to be discovered somewhere on the Island of Lost Treasure, and Blaze and Darington are determined to be the first to find them.
Ryder and the pups must help get a surprise birthday cake up to Jake's cabin; the PAW Patrol must come to the rescue when Alex and Daring Danny X snowboard toward Risky Ridge.
The PAW Patrol must investigate when Farmer Yumi's carrots disappear; Katie wants to enter one of the PAW Patrol in a puppy grooming competition.
Digger and Rocky help Ryder fill the pool with water; the PAW Patrol steps in to help when the animals are late for the circus.

When a homemade robotic dinosaur comes to life, the pups must find him and bring him home; the pups are shooting their film festival entry until Daring Danny X cuts the action with his dangerous stunt.
The Bubble Guppies fly an airplane through the sky.
Molly helps a princess-in-training with her manners, and together they become princesses in the hallowed Glitter Games.
The Bubble Guppies must deal with a difficult customer at their restaurant.

It's lighthouse keeper Deema's birthday, but when a monster named Fogzilla keeps blowing out her lighthouse, she needs to figure out how to get Capt. Molly's ship, carrying her birthday cake to shore, or there won't be a party.
6401d85a49839300087b116c: Faced with a critical blood shortage, a vampire hematologist joins forces with humans to perfect a cure for his problem.
After falling victim to a vampire cult, a reporter (Lucy Liu) joins forces with a grieving detective (Michael Chiklis) to wipe out the bloodthirsty creatures once and for all.
A lawman (Josh Hartnett) and an ever-shrinking band of survivors must fend off hungry vampires who have come to feed during an Alaskan town's annual month of darkness.
The officers of Division 15 work to track down Ted McDonald; but even after catching him, they realize Ted has more targets set to explode out there.
Andy and Sam return to work; Andy is attacked at Traci's apartment and the Sex Crimes Unit tries to take over the case.
Andy contemplates her future with Sam after learning of heartbreaking news; she meets a teenager in need of protection.

6a7cb5b545b3c0d1f72dcca8: Um homem ganha uma fortuna e decide compartilhar o prêmio com as pessoas de sua pequena cidade, mas ele não podia imaginar que o amor seria uma de suas recompensas.

Allie, uma professora de arte desempregada, aceita um trabalho no Esquadrão do Papai Noel para ajudar um viúvo rico e suas filhas a redescobrirem a magia do Natal. Enquanto tenta animar o espírito natalino, Allie é recompensada com o amor.
Uma família passa a época de Natal lutando para salvar sua fazenda histórica em Smoky Mountains.

Olívia, professora de ballet, escolhe a talentosa Lily como protagonista do espetáculo de Natal "O Quebra-Nozes" e acaba se apaixonando pelo pai dela, Michael, um bombeiro atraente. Com a ajuda dele, Olívia tentará salvar seu estúdio de dança.
Um fazendeiro viúvo do Texas convida seu novo lar para conhecer a família no Natal, apenas para descobrir que as alegrias da temporada mascaram um anseio muito mais profundo.

Quando uma companhia de teatro realiza sua troca anual de presentes de amigo secreto, o novo funcionário Glenn recebe Lila, a diretora do teatro, que ele costumava provocar incansavelmente no ensino médio.

Na sequência de “Eu Vou Casar Nesse Natal”, um ano se passou desde o noivado entre Marci e Blair. Mas, com o grande dia se aproximando, Marci tem trabalhado tanto que mal conseguiu planejar seu casamento.

Sara e sua mãe, Michelle, nunca tiveram um ótimo relacionamento. Michelle é o tipo de mãe que sempre quer opinar em tudo: desde as notas de Sara na escola, a escolha de amigos, e até mesmo namorados do colégio.

Krista está começando o ano com um novo negócio e com a resolução de ser mais seletiva com quem namora. Quando Krista conhece Ryan Rourke, um advogado do entretenimento de Los Angeles, os dois realmente se dão bem.
Uma reviravolta faz com que uma estilista passe o Natal com um príncipe.
